blocks.text: Robert Barry: Meta-Concepts
Something that is taking shape in my mind and will sometimes come to consciousness.
Leverkusen Pieces, 1969
Something that is searching for me and needs me to reveal itself.
Leverkusen Pieces, 1969
Something I was once conscious of but have now forgotten.
Leverkusen Pieces, 1969
Something which is unknown to me but which works upon me.
Leverkusen Pieces, 1969
During the Exhibition I will try to communicate telepathically a work of art, the nature of which is a series of thoughts that are not applicable to language or image.
Telepathic Piece, 1969.
IT HAS ORDER
IT IS ALWAYS CHANGING
IT CAN BE PRESENT, BUT GO UNNOTICED
TO KNOW OF IT IS TO BE PART OF IT
IT IS AFFECTED BY OTHER THINGS
IT AFFECTS OTHER THINGS
IT IS NOT CONFINED
IT IS NOT IN ANY SPECIFIC PLACE
Art Work

It is always changing.

It has order.

It doesn't have a specific place.

Its boundaries are not fixed.

It affects other things.

It may be accessible but go unnoticed.

Part of it may also be part of something else.

Some of it is familiar.

Some of it is strange.

Knowing of it changes it.
